cost: O(total form/lemma bytes) normalization plus external matcher cost; D emitted domain occurrences require O(D log D) sorting and O(D) storage. Reading and meaning rendering cost is linear in emitted bytes; matching costs are not measured here.
description: Domain X is tagged calls Lens(W;E) or Means(L), with finite supplied Word sequence W, fixed compiled expression snapshot E and arbitrary finite Reading/Lens values L. No live lexical learning occurs. Let M=expressions_in_sentence(lower(forms W),lower(lemmas W);E). Lens maps each match m in M order to (join(original forms W[m.start..m.end],space),phrase,kind,meaning,register); its domains are sorted unique union of m.domains. Means selects readings whose phrase contains ASCII space, renders text + ' = ' + meaning stripped of every trailing period, joins with '; ', or returns '-' when selection is empty.

inverse: B(tag,y)={tagged inputs and compatible matcher intermediate M satisfying the forward relation and yielding y}. Lens readings lose token boundaries inside joined surfaces and original lemma/head/POS fields; domain union loses occurrence multiplicity and order. Means loses all single-word readings, kind/register/domains and trailing-period multiplicity. Preserve E as a fixed provenance parameter; do not reconstruct one chosen dictionary or original sentence uniquely.
limitations: Finite supplied fixtures; compiled lexical snapshot; partial syntax macro bodies opaque.
No live parser/teacher/corpus, retained exam, intent guarantee or speed claim.
state: For Lens calls, reading count/order equal M count/order; text uses original surfaces, and domains=sort(unique(union domains(M))). For Means calls, only selected readings contribute, in order with multiplicity; empty selection yields '-'. Source-matcher span validity is a dependency premise.
